name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 2 – Am 29
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 2a. Stresses that controversial, polarising or coordinated political communication does not as such constitute FIMI; insists that content-related action under the European Democracy Shield be based on objective and verifiable evidence of foreign direction, funding or operational coordination and must not extend to lawful domestic political expression, advocacy or mobilisation;
